posts.text:
I’m feeling feisty and re-invigorated.  

I’ve felt a lot of pain watching my favour stock decline and know (although I avoid looking and prefer people don’t tell me) there’s been a lot of bashing me. 

I have seen many people call what I’ve said about $hg $hgraf as a shameless promotion. So, this message in response to that. 

Ya… I said it could become a trillion dollar company…. And yes… I still damn well believe it.

Nanotech is a game changer and carbon is the master ingredient.  HG’s ability to mass produce perfect turbostractic fractal graphene with the Hyperion system is an elegant beautiful revolutionary system. 

It stands to be a total game changer for material science and manufacturing.  Basically all manufacturing can benefit and not just the products but the manufacturing equipment as well. 

Yes we are waiting on orders.  But I believe management when they say they are coming and will be plentiful with good margins.  It’s so easy to see this thing 10x from here.  And yes… it could 100x or more.  Eventually hit a trillion in cap if they continue to lead in the experimentations with this material and lay down patent after patent as I believe they are doing with a talented and growing team of PhD’s.

Now to be clear. I’m not saying it will… I’m saying it could achieve these heights.  I said the other day. If it was a private company with Elon as the biggest shareholder and leading the board private equity firms would be fighting to put in $1 bln with a $20 or even $100 bln valuation now.  

It just comes down to confidence that they will get the orders.  I got that confidence and many in the market don’t.  So I’ll get paid when I’m proven right and people flock to the story when it’s on Nasdaq or NYSE or what ever and they are making main stream news globally.  

Never have I seen a tiny cap company lik Hg was with such potential so early on.  It’s a white elephant with a unicorn.   It’s something I never expected to find and doubt I’ll find it again in my life.   It’s just a rare opportunity to be able to find a small cap. Now $1 bln company with this sort of potential.  Understand…. We are talking about revolutionizing how we damn well use carbon. The most important building block in the universe for f$$$ sake.  

So you critics and shorts can chirp away and hope this company flames out cause you’re too lazy to do the work or to dumb to process the volumes of information on the companies graphene.  I despise your kind of unimaginative, hopeless, depressing way of being. lol. 

What keeps me going is hope for companies like this to come along and change the damn trend we are on…. And I don’t mind sticking my neck out and rising embarrassment and putting my money where my mouth is. 

Again…. As always.  Just my thoughts.  Not advice.  Due your own diligence, buy, sell, hold, do nothing, block me, mock me.  I don’t care. 

I just hope the best for the company and everyone who is along for the ride.
